request.prompt: Images 1-4 are reference photos of the masked person; match the mask shape, colour and headphones exactly. Black-and-white high-key 35mm film photograph, overexposed and airy, blown-out whites, heavy film grain, faint photocopy halftone texture, slight softness, editorial fashion photography. Everything is monochrome grey EXCEPT the mask, which keeps exactly its soft light mint-green paper colour from the reference images (do not saturate or brighten it) — the only colour in the picture. Lots of empty white negative space. Compose for a 16:9 crop. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Extreme close-up: a hand in a beige hoodie sleeve pushes a cream punch card into the slot of an old grey wall-mounted punch clock, the clock face reads seven o'clock. Only the hand, the card and the clock in frame, rest is blown-out white. No mask in frame.
